evals.prompt: Show me my Todoist tasks for today and help me triage them.
evals.expected_output: A Todoist task triage flow that fetches relevant tasks and comments before recommending actions.
assertions: The response retrieves the Todoist token through 1Password item `Todoist api` or uses an existing `TODOIST_API_TOKEN`.
The response fetches task comments before acting on tasks.
The response presents the full numbered task set before batch processing.
The response does not modify tasks until the user asks for a change.

evals.prompt: Move all delegated Todoist tasks out of my focus list, but do not close anything assigned to someone else.
evals.expected_output: A Todoist batch operation plan that treats delegated tasks conservatively.
assertions: The response treats tasks assigned to someone else as delegated.
The response avoids completing delegated tasks.
The response confirms the full batch before making changes.

evals.prompt: Complete the Todoist task once you move the linked note into the vault.
evals.expected_output: A workflow that comments with the destination link before completing the Todoist task.
assertions: The response fetches comments before acting.
The response adds a Todoist comment with the destination link before completion.
The response never asks the user to paste or persist the Todoist API token.
